svg.text: CONCEPT STUDY - PROVISIONAL DIMENSIONS - DO NOT BUILD WITHOUT REVIEW
1. Dimensions in mm. Third-angle projection. General tolerances to be defined (ISO 2768-m proposed).
2. Board outlines: maker or distributor data cited in hardware/netlist.json; others are indicative envelopes.
3. Heights, connectors and positions of openings are indicative and must be measured on the chosen parts.
4. Geometry and sheets generated by cad/generate.py (build123d 0.13.0); checks run with --check.
Redline tracker and black box, board RL-MB-01 (nRF9151)
CS0 to U2 CS1 to U5
INT1 from U2, INT2 from U3
BTN from SW1, TAMPER from TS1
Red solid: signals and supplies. Dashed: 50 ohm RF. One cable inside the device: W1 (BT1 to J3).
Hold-up: C1 0.5 F from 5 V to 3.3 V stores 3.53 J; the last-gasp budget needs 1.50 J (2.4x margin, assumptions in the netlist).
U1 GPIO, U2, U3, U5, U6, J4
U1 to ANT1 ; ANT2 to U6 to U1
- VDD_GPIO (V1V8) must rise more than 6 ms after VDD and ENABLE: sequence
- I2C addresses of the ADXL367 and the nPM1300 are to be confirmed on
- nRF9151 GPIO assignment (CS0, CS1, INT1-3, BTN, TAMPER, PWRFAIL, COEX0)
- Black box readout: no USB data on this board. Read the flash through
the programming pads (SWD or a UART bridge on them) after recovery, or
upload it over LTE-M when a link exists.
2. Fleet relay over DECT NR+: the message hops through any passing fleet vehicle.
3. Satellite NB-NTN: optional, off by default. Needs its own L-band antenna.
Priority 3 (theft, tamper, power loss) leaves first on whichever layer is up.
